metadata.title: Contribution of machine learning to the analysis of grade repetition in Spain: A study based on PISA data

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values handling is not applicable because the dependent variables are dichotomous self-reports of grade repetition, not PV-based cognitive achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study reports both unweighted and weighted grade-repetition rates, indicating that the authors applied sampling weights in their analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study used multilevel logistic regression, which accounts for the clustering of students within schools.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions using a training/validation split in the machine-learning workflow, indicating that it performed only internal validation.
